exams.name: Nursing Home Administrator Licensing Examination
exams.notes: May be administered by the department or a certified testing service; board may accept in lieu a certificate, registration or license from another state based on qualifications and examination satisfactory to the board.
exams.jurisdiction: state or authorized testing service certified by the commissioner
exams.quote: Applicants for licensure as nursing home administrators shall be required to pass an examination encompassing the subject matter of the courses of study, instruction, training and experience required by the board and certified by the commissioner.

interval_years.quote: Every licensee must register biennially with the department.

renewal_fee_usd.quote: Such licensee shall promptly fill out, sign and forward such application to the department, together with a fee of forty dollars

required.quote: Registration subsequent to the thirty-first day of December, nineteen hundred seventy-three, shall require satisfactory completion of such continuation education programs or courses of study as the board shall determine are required to assure the licensee's retention of professional competence in nursing home administration

period_years.quote: Every licensee must register biennially with the department.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud or deceit in practice or in procuring the license or registration
disciplinary_grounds.quote: he is guilty of fraud or deceit in his practice or has been guilty of fraud or deceit in procuring his license or registration

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a crime involving moral turpitude
disciplinary_grounds.quote: he has been convicted in a court of competent jurisdiction, either within or without the state, of a crime involving moral turpitude

disciplinary_grounds.description: Alcohol or drug abuse, or mental illness
disciplinary_grounds.quote: he is or has been an alcohol abuser or is or has been addicted to the use of morphine, cocaine or other drugs having similar effect, or has become mentally ill

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding and abetting an unregistered person in practicing nursing home administration
disciplinary_grounds.quote: he has aided and abetted in the practice of nursing home administration a person who is not a registered nursing home administrator

disciplinary_grounds.description: Falsely impersonating a duly registered nursing home administrator or practicing under an assumed name
disciplinary_grounds.quote: he has falsely impersonated a duly registered nursing home administrator or former duly registered nursing home administrator, or is practicing nursing home administration under an assumed name

disciplinary_grounds.description: Guilty of unethical conduct as defined by board rules
disciplinary_grounds.quote: he has been guilty of unethical conduct as defined by rules adopted by the board and certified by the commissioner

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to obtain a certificate of registration as required
disciplinary_grounds.quote: he has not obtained a certificate of registration as required by section two thousand eight hundred ninety-six-g

disciplinary_grounds.description: Intentionally participating as administrator in any act, practice or policy that endangered the health or safety of patients
disciplinary_grounds.quote: as the administrator of a nursing home he has intentionally participated in any act, practice or policy of such nursing home that endangered the health or safety of its patients

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of the requirement to post and provide inspection reports to residents
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The license or registration of a nursing home administrator who violates any of the provisions of this section shall be subject to suspension or revocation

definition_quote.value: Nursing home administrator means an individual who is charged with and has responsibility for the general administration of a nursing home whether or not such individual has an ownership interest in such home and whether or not his functions and duties are shared with one or more other individuals.
definition_quote.quote: "Nursing home administrator" means an individual who is charged with and has responsibility for the general administration of a nursing home whether or not such individual has an ownership interest in such home and whether or not his functions and duties are shared with one or more other individuals.

temporary_permit_available.quote: The board may issue a temporary license to practice nursing home administration, under such conditions and limitations as it shall determine, for a single period not to exceed six months

temporary_permit_max_duration_months.quote: for a single period not to exceed six months

facility_type_covered.quote: "Nursing home" means a facility issued an operating certificate as a nursing home pursuant to article twenty-eight of this chapter.

citizenship_required.quote: all of whom shall be citizens of the United States and residents of the state of New York

experience_substitutable_for_education.quote: an equivalent combination of instruction, training or experience as determined by the board

registration_renewal_interval_years.quote: Every licensee must register biennially with the department.

board_composition_required.value: thirteen members: one physician, one hospital administrator, one professional registered nurse, three nursing home administrators in proprietary homes, three in voluntary homes, three public representatives, one from a college providing training for nursing home administrators
board_composition_required.quote: The board shall be composed of one physician, one hospital administrator, one professional registered nurse, three nursing home administrators employed in proprietary nursing homes and three nursing home administrators employed in voluntary nursing homes, each of whom shall have not less than five years' experience in the care of chronically ill or infirm aged patients. Three members shall be representative of the public and one member shall be appointed from a college providing training for nursing home administrators.

board_member_term_years.quote: The term of office of the members shall be three years

board_member_consecutive_term_limit.quote: No member shall serve for more than two consecutive terms.

automatic_license_suspension_triggers.quote: A conviction of a felony shall forfeit a license to practice nursing home administration and shall be noted on the record of such license, and the license and registration thereunder shall be cancelled

revocation_reinstatement_waiting_period_.quote: Where the license or registration of any person has been revoked or annulled, as herein provided, the board may, after the expiration of two years, entertain an application for restoration of such license or registration.
